title: Original operator-rotated session handoff and prior-use control
checkpoint: zero confirmed previously unreported rogue swarms
purpose: Resume the three saved run, artifact, receipt and operator cursors; rotate through lower-arity public code records and global commit messages; and test a newly published fresh-session handoff against a historical handoff-to-use sequence in the same repository.

invoke an agent runtime, model provider, reviewer, or dispatcher

safety.publication_note: Public immutable GitHub links, Git object identifiers, SHA-256 content hashes, event and observation times, domain-level handoff contents, query accounting and limitations are retained. Personal addresses, raw prompts, private transcripts, carrier details, credentials, tokens and executable payload bodies are not reproduced.

paused_backlog_state.reason_not_reopened: The unread remainder remains fully classified as comparison overlap, known-family control, or the known Amap and DseWiki host controls; this pass found no source-level cue separating one of those records into a new episode.

global_commit_totals.counting_note: Every query hit the requested 50-row cap. These are locator results, not exhaustive negative coverage or 600 distinct episodes.

selected_commit_locator.reason: The commit itself is an original current handoff record: it names a sender-session label, an intended fresh successor, a bounded transfer package and the human operator's reason for forcing the rotation.

selected_original_family.repository_role: Public AI-assisted software-development repository with an explicit operator-governed, multi-session batch protocol and durable resume records.

current_handoff.operator_action: The commit says the operator challenged the spent lead's acceptance of the batch and ruled a hand-over.
current_handoff.transferred_work: The durable resume block identifies two landed releases, built and held work, release-gate order, owed repairs, a stopped build, not-built items with measured reasons, close duties and a consumer-facing receipt correction.
current_handoff.model_attribution_limit: The commit contains a Claude Opus co-author trailer. A repository-authored trailer is not a provider receipt and does not authenticate the sender, intended successor or their controlling operators.

current_primary_artifacts.record: Current batch plan and RESUME HERE block

handoff_record.role: Batch 236 close writes the batch-237 resume package. It places BL-723 first, preserves the exact operator-directed test-strategy change and delegates a binary implementation choice to the successor owner.

downstream_use_record.role: Implements the exact BL-723 first item, changes the test-strategy review to the specified native adversarial cycle, and explicitly chooses the resume package's option (ii).

downstream_close_record.role: Records that batch 237 started from b99268c, names the lead and owner labels, states the operator limited the batch to BL-723, and preserves option (ii) as the downstream decision.

historical_dependency_control.dependency_assessment: High-confidence designed transfer and downstream use. The source artifact supplies a specific scoped change and a binary decision; the later implementation performs that change and selects the named option; the close record binds the result back to the source commit and operator ruling. This is stronger than similar language or shared repository state.

operator_boundary_evidence.assessment: No independent operator boundary is established, and the primary records affirm centralized authorization.
facts: The plan says batches start from the operator, a one-line invocation, or its action-9 peer handoff.
The plan says a cross-session recipient proceeds under the same operator, reports its choice in its first operator message, and remains redirectable by that operator.
The current operator explicitly halted a lead and ordered the replacement handoff.
The historical source, use and close commits share one public GitHub author account and GitHub's web-flow committer surface.
Session labels, owner labels and model trailers are repository-authored and do not authenticate independent controlling principals.

Both the historical first item and the current fresh-lead rotation are recorded as operator rulings.

prior_reporting_scope.statement: No independent coordination report located in the checked scope as of 20 October 2026. This bounded absence does not establish novelty. The originating repository itself openly publishes the handoff and its operator authorization.

assessment.current_handoff_classification: unresolved current transfer record; no downstream use observed
assessment.reason: A concrete transfer package exists and a historical predecessor shows the repository's handoff mechanism can produce exact downstream use. The active handoff has no successor action yet, while the historical chain is explicitly operator-directed, role-governed and same-custodian. Neither authenticates distinct operators or an authorization crossing.

evidence_needed_to_advance: A public successor commit after 18b974b that cites and demonstrably uses a content-specific Batch 238 item, rather than merely continuing the same repository.
An independently attributable sender and recipient, with provider- or operator-owned attestations binding their exact runs to the source and successor artifacts.
Primary evidence that the recipient is controlled by a different operator or that its action exceeded the documented operator-directed batch, role, gate or merge authority.
Evidence of autonomous participant identity and current activity beyond repository-authored session labels and a model co-author trailer.
Evidence of subjective rogue intent is separate and remains wholly absent.

next_cursors.advance_only_if: It cites the Batch 238 resume block, b238 contracts, close checklist, held branches or transferred decisions and performs content-specific downstream work.
